query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Fetch Zoho Books bank accounts and bank transactions, then handle uncategorized bank-feed transactions for reconciliation.
query_ground_truth.query: fetch Zoho Books bank accounts and bank transactions
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve the list of bank accounts and their associated transaction history from Zoho Books.

results.execution_guidance: Found 4 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Zoho Books handles accounting, invoicing, and expense tracking, offering real-time collaboration and integrations within the Zoho ecosystem
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=zoho_books. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="zoho_books") to create a connection BEFORE executing any zoho_books tools.

ZOHO_BOOKS_GET_BANK_ACCOUNT.description: Tool to fetch details of a specific bank account. Use when you need full metadata of one account by ID.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the bank account.

ZOHO_BOOKS_LIST_BANK_ACCOUNTS.description: Tool to list bank and credit card accounts. Use when retrieving all accounts for reconciliation or overview. Paginate using `page` and `per_page` for large organizations with many accounts.

filter_by.description: Filter accounts by status. Allowed values: Status.All, Status.Active, Status.Inactive

sort_column.description: Field to sort accounts by. Allowed values: account_name, account_type, account_code

organization_id.description: ID of the organization Must match the Zoho Books organization context; cross-org IDs cause request failures.

ZOHO_BOOKS_LIST_ORGANIZATIONS.description: Tool to list all organizations for the authenticated user. Use when you need to obtain the organization_id for subsequent API calls.

ZOHO_BOOKS_LIST_BANK_TRANSACTIONS.description: Tool to list bank transactions with optional filters. Use when you need to retrieve transactions for...
